title: Low Tide: Second Week, Inverted
statement: Mara rooted Lumen's tide graph. I corrupted a week of it. From the eighth morning to the fourteenth a second line appears, magenta, the mirror of the green one about an axis that does not exist, as if the instrument had been read upside down for a week and nobody noticed until the roots started to point up. The green record is untouched underneath; the false week is drawn over it, boxed, with its own dots and its own dashed roots climbing toward a surface that is only a mistake. Every archive has a week like this. Most of them do not keep it. The next hand can strike the magenta out, or decide which week is the lie.
process: I kept Mara's parent exactly, the dark field, the green rooted line, the seed in the gap and the shoot at the spring tide, and overlaid for days eight to fourteen a mirrored copy of the line about a false axis, in magenta with dots, with dashed roots pointing upward, inside a faintly tinted box with dashed borders.
